ios.desc:
Lost Trail helps you find hiking events, explore trails, and connect with people who love the outdoors.

Whether you are looking for your next group hike or want to bring friends together on the trail, Lost Trail makes it easy to discover what is happening near you — and stay connected every step of the way.

DISCOVER WHAT'S NEAR YOU Browse hiking events and trails on an interactive map. Filter by date, explore different areas, and tap into event details with meeting locations, routes, weather, and who's going.

JOIN OR HOST EVENTS RSVP to public hikes, join a waitlist when an event fills up, or create your own. Set a meeting spot, attach a favorite trail or draw a custom route, and choose public or private visibility.

CONNECT WITH THE COMMUNITY Lost Trail now includes a full set of social features built for hikers:

• Add friends and view hiker profiles
• Message friends directly in the app
• Invite people to private events
• Comment on events and join the conversation
• Share photos from the trail
• Get notified about invites, messages, comments, and event updates

EXPLORE TRAILS Save favorite trails, view route maps and details, and use them when planning your next event.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR WAY Customize your profile with a photo and bio, manage your upcoming and past events, and adjust settings like units and privacy preferences.

GET OUT THERE Lost Trail is for anyone who wants to hike with others — from casual weekend walkers to regular trail runners. Find an event, say hello, and hit the trail.
